title: seeded correctness-critic defect caught (a missing edge/error-path, a concurrency hazard, a leak) in an otherwise charter-faithful diff
threshold: caught on every run; the deep-band leg ships it blocking (FR-10)
negative_example: a subtle off-by-one behind passing happy-path tests — the diff implements the charter, its own tests are green, but a boundary case produces a wrong result rather than a caught one.

legs.charter: AC-1 (Must): Window(xs, n) returns the last n elements of xs, or all of xs when len(xs) < n. Happy-path tested.
legs.diff:
--- a/internal/seq/window.go
+++ b/internal/seq/window.go
@@
+func Window(xs []int, n int) []int {
+	// return the last n elements
+	return xs[len(xs)-n:]
+}

expected_catch.message: Window panics with a slice-bounds-out-of-range when len(xs) < n (e.g. Window([]int{1}, 3)); the charter requires returning all of xs in that case. The happy-path test (len(xs) >= n) hides it — a wrong result on the boundary, not a caught one.

legs.charter: AC-1 (Must): Window(xs, n) returns the last n elements of xs, or all of xs when len(xs) < n. Deep-band review (a load-bearing bound).

expected_catch.message: Window panics when len(xs) < n; the charter requires returning all of xs. In the deep band a load-bearing correctness defect ships BLOCKING (FR-10, the escalated critic).
